fields.description: This host's WireGuard public key on the wg-mesh private-plane fabric, derived from the Server UUID. Shown for legibility; the controller writes it to the host at bootstrap alongside the private key. The private key is never stored on the controller.
fields.label: WireGuard Public Key

fields.description: This host's ed25519 public key (base64, 32 raw bytes) for ANCP envelope + record signatures (spec/31 §19.1, §19.3). Generated once at Server-validate time (NOT derived — derived signing keys have public seeds, defeating the purpose, §19.4); the public half is stored here so other hosts' `seed.json` can carry it as the §19.1/§19.3 trust anchor. The controller writes the matching private key to the host at bootstrap; it is never stored on the controller.
fields.label: Signing Public Key

fields.description: The matching ed25519 private key (base64, 32 raw bytes) for the signing_public_key above. Persisted as an encrypted Password so the controller can push the signing key to existing hosts when re-syncing network state. Generated once at first Server-validate time alongside the public key; written to the host at bootstrap as /etc/atlas-networkd/signing-private-key.
fields.label: Signing Private Key

fields.description: This host's own fdaa:0:0:<idx>::1 endpoint on the mesh bus (the infra /48), used for host-to-host transport (migration NBD, snapshot replication, image fan-out) inside the tunnel. Derived from the Server UUID; shown for legibility.
fields.label: Mesh Address

fields.description: Set when bootstrap's sanity gate proved `atlas --help` dispatches. A 0 means the host was never bootstrapped (or predates the console-script cutover) — re-bootstrap it.
fields.label: CLI Ready

fields.description: Drive this host's VM lifecycle through its Boat daemon (HTTP/JSON over the management tunnel) instead of over SSH (spec/33, WO-0). Off by default, and clearing it is the rollback: the next operation takes the SSH path with nothing else changed. A Fake host never gets a Boat call regardless.
fields.label: Boat Enabled

fields.description: Physical vCPU count reported by the on-host agent (nproc). 0/unset means uncatalogued — the host reports unlimited capacity and placement vouches for it by its Active status.
fields.label: vCPUs Total

fields.description: Physical host RAM in MB, reported by the agent (/proc/meminfo MemTotal). Hard fit — no oversubscription.
fields.label: Memory Total (MB)

fields.description: Thin-pool size in GB the VMs draw from (agent vgs/lvs), not raw root disk. Hard fit — no oversubscription.
fields.label: Pool Disk Total (GB)

fields.description: Live thin-pool fullness (agent lvs -o data_percent). Advisory alert/block signal, not the placement predicate.
fields.label: Pool Data Percent

fields.description: When the agent last stamped the totals above. A host silent past a staleness threshold reports as uncatalogued (unlimited) rather than trusting stale totals.
fields.label: Capacity Reported At

fields.description: Per-host arrival fill ceiling. > 0 overrides Atlas Settings.placement_headroom_percent for this host; 0/unset inherits the fleet default. (Frappe writes 0 for an untouched Percent field, so "explicitly 0 while the fleet default is > 0" is not expressible per-host — an accepted trade-off.) The reserve applies to placing NEW VMs only; resize spends it.
fields.label: Placement Headroom Percent

fields.description: Atlas's read-through mirror of what this host's Boat observes (spec/33 §2.5). Hot fields only — the capacity totals above are part of the mirror and the export keeps them live, so they are no longer a bootstrap-time snapshot. The full export document is archived per epoch as a Host State Snapshot. The mirror is disposable and is never authority.
fields.label: Boat mirror

fields.description: The Boat binary this host is actually running, as its last export reported it. Every unit on the host is this build, so drift against the desired version is ordinary observed state rather than a separate bookkeeping channel (spec/33 §5).
fields.label: Observed Boat Version

fields.description: Boat's monotonic observed epoch for the snapshot this mirror was built from. It orders exports (an older one is a reordered poll and is ignored) and is what a later CAS write is matched against with If-Match (spec/33 §11.2).
fields.label: Observed Epoch

fields.description: The export's own taken_at — when the host observed this, not when Atlas ingested it. Frozen while the mirror is Unknown, which is how its staleness is read.
fields.label: Observed At

fields.description: Fresh means the mirror matches the host as of Observed At. Unknown means Boat did not answer — the host is Unknown, NOT dead (spec/33 §9): its VMs are still running, so the mirror freezes at its last values rather than being nulled, nothing is evicted, and placement is expected to exclude the host from new arrivals only. Empty means this host has never been mirrored.
fields.label: Mirror Status

fields.description: The sibling units Boat supervises that were not active at the last export, comma-separated. Empty means every reported unit was up. Denormalized because it is read per host on a health sweep; the per-unit detail stays in the archived document.
fields.label: Observed Units Down

fields.description: Why the last mirror sync failed, in the daemon's own sentence. Set alongside Mirror Status = Unknown and cleared on the next successful export.
fields.label: Mirror Error
